ruling: allowed by Michael's ruling, 11 Nov 2026: the collector may read any outlet page served publicly to a plain request, regardless of robots.txt or terms wording. Limits: no bypassing technical blocks (403, CAPTCHA, login, paywall; no proxies, no disguised user agent, no headless browser); only the quoted words, speaker and labelling context are kept, never article text; at most one section request per outlet every 30 minutes, article pages fetched once; "enabled": false switches an outlet off and hides its items; ATP stays on the permission route; YouTube audio, the Tennis TV stream and tennisformterminal.com stay out.
